level.label: 1. OG — extrapolated study
level.source: Repeated from the current corrected House 55 2. OG study at the resident’s request; this lower floor has not been separately mapped.
level.notes: Rooms, stairs, landings, circulation and doorways repeat the current corrected 2. OG core as an unverified extrapolation. The L-block overlap and staircase alignment therefore no longer show the earlier sketch. The complete source floor plate is retained, and additional lower-floor wings remain unassigned. The 20 displayed study references are not a confirmed or complete count for this lower floor. Top-floor window observations and wall-material hypotheses have not been copied.
